newsitem.title: USA: Entergy mum on possible Yorkshire bid.
newsitem.headline: Entergy mum on possible Yorkshire bid.

text.p: Entergy Corp on Monday refused further comment on a possible bid for Yorkshire Electricty Plc, other than to say that a published report about a possible bid was wrong.
A story in London's Sunday Telegraph said the New Orleans-based company was considering a friendly bid of about 1.3 billion stg for Yorkshire.

"I can tell you right now that the content of the Sunday Telegraph story is wrong. We've not approached Yorkshire with any proposal, and we've not talked to them, as far as I know," Entergy spokesman Patrick Sweeney said.
He added, "The second part of that is, we simply don't comment on situations until they get to a point until it is prudent to do so."
